# Mobile Phone Manager (MPM)

**Author:** BenQ Mobile GmbH & Co. OHG<br/>
**Platforms:** x65/x75 (SGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![Mobile Phone Manager (MPM): screenshot 1](./mobile-phone-manager/img/mobile-phone-manager.png)

</div>

Official software for managing BenQ-Siemens phones. It includes a file manager,
contact and calendar synchronization with Microsoft Outlook,
backup and restore, messaging and
multimedia features, as well as Mobile Modem Assistant for connecting a computer to
the Internet through the phone.

The phone can be connected via USB, IrDA, or Bluetooth. This build fully
works with E71 and EL71.
